articles.title: Stripe’s $53 billion PayPal bid is a high-stakes play to own the future of digital payments
articles.snippet: If Stripe acquires PayPal, the real prize could be consumer wallets, stablecoin issuance or the infrastructure powering the next generation of digital payments.

articles.title: Visa backs Open USD with new stablecoin platform as Circle faces fresh competition
articles.snippet: Visa launched a stablecoin platform that lets banks and fintechs issue, manage and settle digital dollars through its payments network.

articles.title: Galaxy targets institutional stablecoin yield with new DeFi vaults
articles.snippet: The crypto financial services firm launched Galaxy Curator, a Morpho-based platform that gives Fireblocks' 2,400 institutional clients access to onchain yield strategies.

articles.title: OKX Europe lets users convert USDT to MiCA-compliant USDC
articles.snippet: The feature offers European customers a voluntary path away from Tether’s USDT as MiCA rules reshape the region’s stablecoin market.

articles.title: SBI acquires Singaporean crypto platform Coinhako after MAS approval
articles.snippet: SBI Holdings received regulatory approval to acquire a majority stake in Singapore-based crypto exchange Coinhako as it expands into stablecoins, onchain finance and tokenized assets.
